title: Madrid · Sierra de Guadarrama Mountain Day
slogan: A 166 km loop out of Navacerrada Pass
story: High plateau air and historic stops north of the city. 166 km round from Cercedilla - plan on about 3 h 12 of riding. It goes by way of Segovia old town, La Granja palace and Rascafría. Navacerrada Pass is the high point. It tops out at about 1,350 m. The passes are the reason to go.
